mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} (primary_key, enterprise_code, contract_code, buss_number, main_id, produce_main_id, report_main_id, inspect_origin_type, inspect_origin_name, procedure_code, procedure_name, product_or_part_code, product_or_part_name, related_name, related_code, model, pcs_name, inspect_num, un_pass_num, un_pass_deal_conclusion, un_pass_deal, inspect_user_code, inspect_user_name, files, batch, batch_global_code, product_flag, remark) VALUES (#{data.primaryKeyValue}, #{data.enterpriseCode}, #{data.contractCode}, #{data.bussNumber}, #{data.mainId}, #{data.produceMainId}, #{data.reportMainId}, #{data.inspectOriginType}, #{data.inspectOriginName}, #{data.procedureCode}, #{data.procedureName}, #{data.productOrPartCode}, #{data.productOrPartName}, #{data.relatedName}, #{data.relatedCode}, #{data.model}, #{data.pcsName}, #{data.inspectNum}, #{data.unPassNum}, #{data.unPassDealConclusion}, #{data.unPassDeal}, #{data.inspectUserCode}, #{data.inspectUserName}, #{data.files}, #{data.batch}, #{data.batchGlobalCode}, #{data.productFlag}, #{data.remark})
mapper.select:
with t as (select a.finish_main_id as main_id, a.inspect_type, a.inspect_ratio, 2 as originType, '成品检' as originTypeName from ${finishDispatcherTable} a where a.finish_main_id = #{mainId} and a.delete_flag = false union select a.into_main_id, a.inspect_type, a.inspect_ratio, 3 as originType, '入库检' as originTypeName from ${intoDispatcherTable} a where a.into_main_id = #{mainId} and a.delete_flag = false UNION select a.process_main_id, a.inspect_type, a.inspect_ratio, 1 as originType, '过程检' as originTypeName from ${processDispatcherTable} a where a.process_main_id = #{mainId} and a.delete_flag = false) , t1 as (select a.model, a.product_or_part_name as name, a.check_items as checkItemsStr from ${finishTable} a where primary_key = #{mainId} and a.delete_flag = false union select a.model , a.product_or_part_name as name , a.check_items as checkItemsStr from ${intoTable} a where primary_key = #{mainId} and a.delete_flag = false union select a.model , a.procedure_name as name , a.check_items as checkItemsStr from ${processTable} a where primary_key = #{mainId} and a.delete_flag = false)
select * from t, t1

select t.submit_user_code as code, t1.staff_sign as name from (select submit_user_code from ${repairSubmitTable} a where a.report_main_id = #{reportMainId} and a.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and a.delete_flag = false and a.status = 4 and a.submit_num > 0 GROUP BY submit_user_code) t, ${staffTable} t1 where t.submit_user_code = t1.primary_key
